XRayXLPerfetto

Open a trace in Perfetto

Converts an XRayXL trace for Perfetto UI, the trace viewer, inside this page.

Trace

An XRayXL_Trace_<id>_<pid>.csv or .jsonl file from %TEMP%\XRayXL\TraceFiles, or drop one anywhere on this page.

What's in it
Open it

Perfetto opens in a new tab and asks whether to trust “An unknown origin”: that is this page, so answer Yes. A downloaded .pftrace opens later in any Perfetto UI.

Converted inside this page, so nothing is uploaded. Perfetto UI keeps the trace in this browser, with sharing turned off.
